question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom that can be substituted in the following sentence.**

He is not a great leader but, he has the __**gift of gab**__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"gift of speaking."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "gift of gab" **means the ability to speak confidently and persuasively. (आत्मविश्वास से और प्रेरक ढंग से बोलने की क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example**: *My friend had the **gift of the gab**__ and gradually defused the situation.*
 
 
 
• **"Gift of speaking"** means the capacity for assured and convincing speech. (आश्वस्त करने वाले भाषण की क्षमता)
 
• It is often used to describe someone who is a smooth talker or a good conversationalist.
 
• In the given sentence, it means that the person may not be a great leader but he can speak well.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
